eli: Heads-up: onboarding hit a weird edge case on Cloudflare Pages. Customer used vite to bundle an app that imports @redwood/inference and got ReferenceError: process is not defined.

nina: Repro looks like vite pulled in a transitive `events` polyfill via a helper. CF Pages runtime doesn't have process or Buffer.

priya: Two concurrent DX issues: (1) runtime errors from Node globals leaking into bundles, (2) our types referencing NodeJS.Timer which breaks tsc when users set `lib: ['webworker']`.

sam: Quick workaround I used locally: publish a dedicated small ESM entrypoint `dist/esm-edge/index.mjs` and set package.json exports so bundlers pick it for edge targets. That build avoids node libs and keeps size tiny.

eli: Notes on shims: don't ship heavy ponyfills by default (fast-webcrypto etc.). Instead provide an opt-in edge-shim that does feature-detection and only supplies minimal fallbacks (tiny abortcontroller shim, a minimal digest fallback if crypto.subtle missing). Example snippet we used in the shim:```js
if (!globalThis.AbortController) {
  globalThis.AbortController = class { constructor(){ this.aborted = false; this.signal = { aborted: false } } abort(){ this.aborted = true; this.signal.aborted = true } }
}
```

nina: Important: avoid Buffer in these shims. Use TextEncoder/TextDecoder + base64 helpers that don't rely on Node. Buffer usage caused more shims to be pulled in.

priya: Types plan: produce two sets of d.ts and map them via exports -> types. Edge types should reference DOM/Web libs only. Also remove NodeJS.Timeout usage in public retry types (use ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> or number unions).

sam: Auth: edge build must not bundle `jsonwebtoken` or fs-based refresh flows. Provide a fetch-based refresh helper for edge that calls our token endpoint and returns the token; keep it tiny and documented as the recommended edge pattern.

eli: Action items: sam -> create tsup/rollup `esm-edge` target and examples/workers/pages-minimal.mjs; priya -> split types and add edge d.ts; nina -> docs + bundler config snippets (vite/esbuild) and note gotchas; I'll coordinate release notes and CI smoke tests via wrangler/miniflare.

wrangler-bot: ci: queued workers-pages-smoke #7890

priya: Also add a short checklist in onboarding docs: "If running on Cloudflare Pages/Workers, prefer import from "@redwood/inference/esm-edge" and follow bundler recommendations."

eli: Good. Let's keep shims opt-in and documented. We can revisit adding small guarded shims in the package when customers ask, but default should be zero node-polyfills. :white_check_mark:
